notes.title: Adult DLC now available
notes.notes:
While this DLC has been available for a while in some other of our developer pages, we wanted to streamline the patching process for those interested. Enjoy!

[i]Please take into account that this DLC adds adult content to the game, it's marked as such on Steam and by installing it you confirm you're over 18 years of age.[/i]

notes.title: Steam achievementes
notes.notes:
Steam achievements are now available! Each achievement corresponds to one of the good endings.

Because we made some changes on our end, if you have problems launching the game, please make sure that it's been updated to the latest version, or reinstall it.

notes.title: Spanish language
notes.notes:
We've updated the game to add:

-[b] Spanish language. [/b]The entire game is now playable in Spanish.
-[b] Patch compatibility.[/b] See our itchio and/or social media for more details.

Additionally, we've tidied up spelling mistakes. 

Thank you for your support!
